description: Whether the person's connector is connected now: waiting-for-connector (nobody has run the setup command yet, or it stopped long ago), connected, degraded (connected with fewer links than it should have) or down, with how many links it holds. Only owners and admins can check.

name.description: The network's name: 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting and ending with a letter or digit (office, plant-2). A database connection names it in its Private network setting.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: check_private_network
title: Is the network connected
